description: This file defines the CatalogViewModelService class, which is a UI-specific service responsible for retrieving catalog items, brands, and types for display in an e-commerce web application. It works with view models and repositories to fetch data asynchronously, generate view models, and provide selection lists.

classes.name: CatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A service class responsible for fetching catalog data and converting it into view models and select list items for the UI.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Retrieves paginated catalog items filtered by optional brand and type IDs, constructs a view model with items, filters, and pagination info.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Fetches all available brands and returns them as a list of select list items with an 'All' option.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Fetches all available types and returns them as a list of select list items with an 'All' option.
